poms.name: Chest circumference, 1" (2.54 cm) below armhole
poms.arabic: محيط الصدر: يُقاس أفقياً على بُعد 1 إنش (2.54 سم) تحت نقطة الإبط، من خياطة الجنب إلى خياطة الجنب، والقيمة هي المحيط الكامل (العرض المسطح × 2).
poms.method: Straight across the body at 1" below the armhole point, side seam to side seam; reported as full circumference (flat width × 2).
poms.start: Side seam, 1" below left armhole point
poms.end: Side seam, 1" below right armhole point

source.name: Golden Bear Sportswear — Classic Fit size chart

poms.referenceLabel: REFERENCE — NOT YET JACKETEK PRODUCTION APPROVED

poms.name: Waist circumference
poms.arabic: محيط الخصر: عرض الجسم الأفقي عند مستوى الخصر (على مسافة ثابتة من نقطة الكتف العليا HPS تُحدَّد لاحقاً)، المحيط الكامل.
poms.method: Straight across the body at a fixed distance below HPS (distance to be fixed by pattern maker), side seam to side seam × 2.
poms.end: Opposite side seam at waist level

poms.name: Body width at waistband seam (above rib)
poms.arabic: عرض الجسم عند خياطة تركيب الحزام المطاطي (فوق الرِّب مباشرة)، المحيط الكامل.
poms.method: Along the seam joining body to waistband rib, side to side, × 2.

poms.name: Bottom opening, relaxed
poms.arabic: فتحة الأسفل وهي مرتخية: محيط الحافة السفلية للحزام المطاطي دون أي شد.
poms.method: Along the finished bottom edge of the waistband rib, relaxed, × 2.
poms.end: Bottom edge at opposite side fold

poms.name: Bottom opening, extended
poms.arabic: فتحة الأسفل مشدودة: محيط الحافة السفلية للحزام المطاطي عند شدّه إلى أقصى امتداد دون إجهاد الغرز.
poms.method: Same line as B04, stretched to full extension without straining stitches, × 2.
poms.end: Bottom edge at opposite side fold

poms.name: Centre-back length
poms.arabic: الطول من منتصف الظهر: من منتصف الظهر عند خياطة الياقة نزولاً حتى الحافة السفلية للحزام. (نقطة البداية عند Golden Bear غير محددة — انظر القسم 4.)
poms.method: Vertical along the CB line from the CB neck point to the finished bottom edge. Golden Bear's start point is NOT stated (see §4).
poms.start: CB neck (collar seam — UNCONFIRMED for source)
poms.end: Finished bottom edge of waistband rib (UNCONFIRMED for source)

source.name: Golden Bear Sportswear — Classic Fit size chart

poms.referenceLabel: REFERENCE — NOT YET JACKETEK PRODUCTION APPROVED

poms.name: Back length from HPS
poms.arabic: الطول الخلفي من نقطة الكتف العليا (HPS) حتى الحافة السفلية، يُقاس على الظهر موازياً لمنتصف الظهر.
poms.method: From HPS straight down, parallel to CB, to the finished bottom edge (back view). Measured to reconcile B06's start point.

poms.name: Front length from HPS
poms.arabic: الطول الأمامي: من نقطة الكتف العليا (التقاء الكتف بالياقة) نزولاً موازياً لمنتصف الأمام حتى الحافة السفلية.
poms.method: From HPS straight down, parallel to CF, to the finished bottom edge.

poms.name: Across shoulder
poms.arabic: عرض الكتفين: من نقطة الكتف إلى نقطة الكتف (عند خياطة تركيب الكم) عبر الظهر.
poms.method: Straight line across the back from shoulder point to shoulder point (armhole seam at the shoulder). Straight vs contour NOT stated by source (see §4).

source.name: Golden Bear Sportswear — Classic Fit size chart

poms.referenceLabel: REFERENCE — NOT YET JACKETEK PRODUCTION APPROVED

poms.name: Shoulder length
poms.arabic: طول الكتف: من نقطة الكتف العليا (HPS) إلى نقطة الكتف عند خياطة الكم.
poms.method: Along the shoulder seam from HPS to shoulder point.

poms.name: Shoulder drop
poms.arabic: ميل الكتف: الفرق العمودي بين مستوى نقطة الكتف العليا ومستوى نقطة الكتف.
poms.method: Vertical distance between the HPS level and the shoulder-point level.

poms.name: Across front
poms.arabic: عرض الأمام: المسافة بين خياطتي تركيب الكم من الأمام، على مسافة ثابتة تحت HPS.
poms.method: Armhole seam to armhole seam across the front at a fixed distance below HPS (distance set by pattern maker).

poms.name: Across back
poms.arabic: عرض الظهر: المسافة بين خياطتي تركيب الكم من الخلف، على مسافة ثابتة تحت HPS.
poms.method: Armhole seam to armhole seam across the back at a fixed distance below HPS.

poms.name: Armhole depth
poms.arabic: عمق الإبط: المسافة العمودية من نقطة الكتف العليا (HPS) إلى مستوى نقطة الإبط.
poms.method: Vertical from HPS level to the armhole point (underarm) level.

poms.name: Armhole, straight
poms.arabic: فتحة الإبط المستقيمة: خط مستقيم من نقطة الكتف إلى نقطة الإبط، والجاكيت مسطح.
poms.method: Straight line from shoulder point to armhole point, garment flat.

poms.name: Armhole, curved (along seam)
poms.arabic: طول خط الإبط المنحني: يُقاس على طول خياطة تركيب الكم (الأمام + الخلف).
poms.method: Along the armhole seam, front + back, shoulder point round to shoulder point.

poms.name: Sleeve length from centre back
poms.arabic: طول الكم من منتصف الظهر: من منتصف الظهر عند الرقبة، مروراً بنقطة الكتف، على طول أعلى الكم حتى حافة الكم. (المسار ونقطة البداية والنهاية غير محددة عند المصدر.)
poms.method: From the CB neck point across the shoulder to the shoulder point, then down the overarm to the cuff edge. Source does not state start, path or end (see §4).

source.name: Golden Bear Sportswear — Classic Fit size chart

poms.referenceLabel: REFERENCE — NOT YET JACKETEK PRODUCTION APPROVED

poms.name: Sleeve length from shoulder point (overarm)
poms.arabic: طول الكم من نقطة الكتف: من نقطة الكتف على طول الخط العلوي للكم حتى حافة الكم.
poms.method: From shoulder point along the overarm to the finished cuff edge.

poms.name: Underarm sleeve length
poms.arabic: طول الكم الداخلي: من نقطة الإبط على طول خياطة الكم الداخلية حتى حافة الكم.
poms.method: From armhole point along the underarm seam to the finished cuff edge.

poms.name: Bicep width, 1" below armhole
poms.arabic: عرض العضد: عرض الكم المسطح على بُعد 1 إنش (2.54 سم) تحت الإبط، عمودياً على خط الكم (نصف المحيط).
poms.method: Flat width perpendicular to the sleeve centre line, 1" below the armhole point (half circumference).

poms.name: Elbow width
poms.arabic: عرض الكوع: عرض الكم المسطح عند مستوى الكوع (على مسافة ثابتة من نقطة الكتف تُحدَّد لاحقاً).
poms.method: Flat width perpendicular to the sleeve line at a fixed distance from shoulder point (distance set by pattern maker).

poms.name: Sleeve width at cuff seam (above rib)
poms.arabic: عرض الكم عند خياطة تركيب رِب الكم (فوق الرِّب مباشرة).
poms.method: Flat width along the seam joining sleeve to cuff rib.

poms.name: Cuff opening, relaxed
poms.arabic: فتحة الكم وهي مرتخية: عرض الحافة النهائية للكم دون شد.
poms.method: Flat width along the finished cuff edge, relaxed.

poms.name: Cuff opening, extended
poms.arabic: فتحة الكم مشدودة: عرض الحافة النهائية للكم عند شدّها إلى أقصى امتداد.
poms.method: Flat width along the finished cuff edge, stretched to full extension.

poms.name: Cuff rib height
poms.arabic: ارتفاع رِب الكم: من خياطة تركيب الرِّب حتى حافة الكم النهائية.
poms.method: From the cuff seam to the finished cuff edge.

poms.name: Sleeve cap height (pattern)
poms.arabic: ارتفاع رأس الكم: قياس على الباترون (وليس على القطعة الجاهزة) يحدده الباترونيست.
poms.method: Pattern measurement: from the bicep line to the top of the sleeve cap on the sleeve pattern.

poms.name: Waistband rib height
poms.arabic: ارتفاع رِب الحزام السفلي: من خياطة التركيب حتى الحافة السفلية.
poms.method: From the waistband seam to the finished bottom edge, at CB.

poms.name: Waistband rib cut length
poms.arabic: طول قصّ رِب الحزام: يُحسب من فتحة الأسفل المعتمدة ونسبة شد الرِّب التي يحددها الباترونيست.
poms.method: Computed from approved bottom opening (B03/B04) and the rib-to-opening ratio set by the pattern maker.

poms.name: Cuff rib cut length
poms.arabic: طول قصّ رِب الكم: يُحسب من عرض الكم المعتمد عند الخياطة ونسبة الشد.
poms.method: Computed from approved sleeve width at cuff seam (S06) and the rib ratio.

poms.name: Collar rib cut length
poms.arabic: طول قصّ رِب الياقة: يُحسب من طول خط الرقبة المعتمد ونسبة الشد.
poms.method: Computed from approved collar neck-edge length (C03) and the rib ratio.

poms.name: Rib stripe layout (count, stripe widths, distance from edge)
poms.arabic: تصميم الخطوط على الرِّب: عدد الخطوط وعرض كل خط وبُعدها عن الحافة (للياقة والكم والحزام).
poms.method: Per rib piece: number of stripes, each stripe width and its distance from the finished edge.

poms.name: Collar height at CB
poms.arabic: ارتفاع الياقة عند منتصف الظهر: من خياطة تركيب الياقة حتى حافتها الخارجية.
poms.method: At CB, from the collar seam to the collar's outer edge, collar standing/unfolded.

poms.name: Collar height at front ends
poms.arabic: ارتفاع الياقة عند طرفيها الأماميين.
poms.method: At the collar's front end, from collar seam to outer edge.
poms.end: Collar outer edge at front end

poms.name: Collar neck-edge length (attached edge)
poms.arabic: طول الياقة عند خط التركيب: من الطرف الأمامي إلى الطرف الأمامي الآخر على طول خياطة الرقبة.
poms.method: Along the collar seam from front end to front end.

poms.name: Collar outer-edge length, relaxed
poms.arabic: طول الحافة الخارجية للياقة وهي مرتخية.
poms.method: Along the collar's outer edge from front end to front end, relaxed.

poms.name: Neck width, seam to seam
poms.arabic: عرض فتحة الرقبة: المسافة المستقيمة بين نقطتي الكتف العليا (HPS) عند خياطة الياقة.
poms.method: Straight line between left and right HPS at the collar seam.

poms.name: Front neck drop
poms.arabic: انخفاض الرقبة الأمامي: المسافة العمودية من خط HPS إلى أدنى نقطة في خياطة الياقة عند منتصف الأمام.
poms.method: Vertical from the HPS line to the collar seam at CF.

poms.name: Back neck drop
poms.arabic: انخفاض الرقبة الخلفي: المسافة العمودية من خط HPS إلى خياطة الياقة عند منتصف الظهر.
poms.method: Vertical from the HPS line to the collar seam at CB.

poms.name: Front placket / facing width (finished)
poms.arabic: عرض المرد الأمامي (شريط الكبسات) بعد التشطيب.
poms.method: Finished width of the snap placket/facing, perpendicular to the front edge.

poms.name: Front overlap (CF to front edge)
poms.arabic: التراكب الأمامي: المسافة من خط منتصف الأمام إلى حافة الأمام العلوية.
poms.method: From the CF line to the overlapping front edge.

poms.name: Snap count
poms.arabic: عدد الكبسات في الأمام.
poms.method: Number of snap sets on the front closure (count, not a length).

poms.name: Top snap position below neck seam
poms.arabic: موضع الكبسة العليا: المسافة من خياطة الياقة عند الأمام حتى مركز الكبسة.
poms.method: From the collar seam at the front edge down to the top snap centre.

poms.name: Bottom snap position above bottom edge
poms.arabic: موضع الكبسة السفلى: المسافة من الحافة السفلية حتى مركز الكبسة (أو على رِب الحزام).
poms.method: From the finished bottom edge up to the bottom snap centre.

poms.name: Snap spacing (centre to centre)
poms.arabic: المسافة بين الكبسات (من المركز إلى المركز): تُحسب من عدد الكبسات وموضعي العليا والسفلى.
poms.method: Computed from F03–F05 (equal spacing unless the pattern maker specifies otherwise).

poms.name: Snap centre from front edge
poms.arabic: بُعد مركز الكبسة عن حافة الأمام.
poms.method: Perpendicular from the front edge to the snap centre.

poms.name: Pocket opening length
poms.arabic: طول فتحة الجيب: على طول الفتحة من طرف إلى طرف.
poms.method: Along the pocket opening, end to end.

poms.name: Pocket welt width
poms.arabic: عرض شريط الجيب (الويلت).
poms.method: Finished welt width, perpendicular to the opening.

poms.name: Pocket position below HPS (top of opening)
poms.arabic: موضع الجيب العمودي: من HPS حتى الطرف العلوي لفتحة الجيب.
poms.method: Vertical from HPS to the upper end of the pocket opening.

poms.name: Pocket position from CF (top of opening)
poms.arabic: موضع الجيب الأفقي: من منتصف الأمام حتى الطرف العلوي لفتحة الجيب.
poms.method: Horizontal from CF to the upper end of the pocket opening.

poms.name: Pocket opening angle
poms.arabic: زاوية فتحة الجيب بالنسبة للخط العمودي.
poms.method: Angle of the opening from vertical (degrees).

poms.name: Pocket bag depth
poms.arabic: عمق كيس الجيب الداخلي.
poms.method: From the opening's lower end to the bottom of the pocket bag.

poms.name: Pocket bag width
poms.arabic: عرض كيس الجيب الداخلي.
poms.method: Widest point of the pocket bag.

poms.name: Lining CB length relative to shell
poms.arabic: طول البطانة عند منتصف الظهر مقارنةً بالقماش الخارجي (مقدار الزيادة أو الثنية).
poms.method: Difference between lining CB length and shell CB length (jump/ease allowance).

poms.name: Lining sleeve length relative to shell
poms.arabic: طول بطانة الكم مقارنةً بالكم الخارجي.
poms.method: Difference between lining sleeve length and shell sleeve length.

poms.name: Lining chest width relative to shell
poms.arabic: عرض البطانة عند الصدر مقارنةً بالقماش الخارجي (مع مراعاة سماكة الحشوة إن وُجدت).
poms.method: Difference between lining chest and shell chest, allowing for quilt/wadding bulk.

poms.name: Inside pocket opening (if fitted)
poms.arabic: فتحة الجيب الداخلي في البطانة (إن وُجد — غير مقرر بعد).
poms.method: Opening length of an inside lining pocket. Whether one is fitted is undecided.

referenceValues.label: REFERENCE — NOT YET JACKETEK PRODUCTION APPROVED

secondaryVisualReference.role: JACKETEK visual fit reference / secondary benchmark
secondaryVisualReference.origin: Size chart supplied by JACKETEK; brand, URL and measuring method not independently verified
purpose: Confirm the preferred silhouette is numerically close to Golden Bear Classic M
Help define the JACKETEK target fit
secondaryVisualReference.gradingNote: The chart's XS–4XL progression appears irregular and is deliberately not recorded or copied.

methods.chestHalfFlatCm: half / flat chest; height below armhole not known
methods.sleeveFromShoulderSeamCm: from shoulder seam; end point not known

comparisonWithGoldenBearM.caveat: GB value is the published circumference ÷ 2 (1" below armhole). Where the visual chart measures its half chest (pit-to-pit at the armhole, or lower) is not known.
Neither chart states straight vs contour.
GB is centre-back length (start point not stated). The visual chart's start point (CB collar seam, top of collar or HPS) is not known.

sleeveNotCompared.reason: Golden Bear measures from centre back; this chart from the shoulder seam.
sleeveNotCompared.arithmeticFlag: CB sleeve − half across shoulder on Golden Bear M = 65.41 cm (arithmetic only, not a published POM). The visual chart's 51 cm is far shorter, so its sleeve method (end point, or underarm rather than overarm) must be confirmed before it informs any sleeve decision.

provisionalTargetRangeM.label: PROVISIONAL TARGET RANGE — REQUIRES SAMPLE APPROVAL
provisionalTargetRangeM.note: Not a production spec. Ends are the two references' M values (Golden Bear rounded to 0.1 cm). No sleeve target: the two charts measure the sleeve differently.

options.name: Buy and measure Golden Bear Classic M
options.accuracy: Highest for the reference itself: settles all 11 Golden Bear method questions on a real garment. Says nothing about JACKETEK materials (leather / cotton fabric), the dropped-vs-set-in question (K1), the zones or the visually preferred silhouette.
options.cost: Retail price of one jacket plus international shipping and import duty (check the current price; not researched here). No pattern cost.
options.speed: Depends on international shipping and customs. Measuring takes about a day once it arrives.
options.risk: Low risk of wasted money, but it is an extra step: a JACKETEK prototype is still required afterwards. If Golden Bear's methods are confirmed, nothing about JACKETEK's own fit has been tested yet.
options.lockingValue: Locks the 4 reference values and their methods. Helps with about 33 sample measurements only as a benchmark garment (its armhole, rib, collar, etc. are Golden Bear's, not JACKETEK's). Locks no pattern-maker decision.

options.name: JACKETEK M prototype from the factory / pattern maker, built to the provisional target range using Golden Bear's measuring methods
options.accuracy: Tests the real product: JACKETEK materials, construction, rib, zones and the fit on a body. The 3 main dimensions already have two independent charts within about 1.2 cm of each other, so the method ambiguities are small next to fit approval. The Golden Bear method questions stay open unless the factory documents its own methods.
options.cost: One pattern plus one sample (factory quote needed; not researched here). Likely one or more revision rounds whichever option is chosen.
options.speed: Removes the purchase-and-shipping step; depends on the factory's pattern and sampling lead time.
options.risk: The pattern maker interprets an ambiguous method differently (e.g. body length from HPS instead of the CB collar seam). Controlled by giving them this document's method definitions and requiring a measured spec back. The sleeve has no sourced target and must be set on the fit model.
options.lockingValue: Directly produces most of what v1.0 needs: the 33 sample measurements, the 15 pattern-maker decisions, rib and snap specs and the 10 zone geometries, all on the actual JACKETEK garment.

recommendation: Choose B. The Golden Bear purchase is no longer strictly necessary: the visual chart already confirms Golden Bear Classic M's chest, shoulder and length within about 1.2 cm, and the remaining unknowns are JACKETEK-specific, which only a JACKETEK prototype can answer.

Before ordering, decide K1 (set-in vs dropped shoulder) and say whether the jacket in the visual chart has a dropped shoulder. The 50 cm shoulder makes sense only for the construction it was measured on.

Give the factory this document. Require: the provisional target range for chest, shoulder and body length; Golden Bear's method definitions (§4) for every POM; and a sleeve length set on the fit model, not taken from either chart.
Require the factory to return the measured spec of the prototype using the §10 checklist, with each POM's method written down, plus the flat photos with a ruler.
Keep A as a fallback: buy a Golden Bear Classic M only if the prototype misses the target range in a way that can't be explained, or if the factory can't measure to the documented methods.

methodAmbiguities.title: Centre-back length: start point not stated
methodAmbiguities.detail: Header reads only "Center back". Could be from the CB collar seam, from the top of the collar, or from HPS. A collar is roughly a rib's height, so the choice moves the value by that amount.

methodAmbiguities.title: Centre-back length: end point not stated
methodAmbiguities.detail: Assumed to be the finished bottom edge of the waistband rib (rib included). Not stated.

methodAmbiguities.title: Sleeve from CB: start point not stated
methodAmbiguities.detail: "From center back" — CB at the collar seam is assumed; the top of the collar is also used in the trade.

methodAmbiguities.title: Sleeve from CB: path not stated
methodAmbiguities.detail: Whether the tape follows the shoulder seam to the shoulder point and then the overarm, or runs straight from CB to the cuff, is not stated.

methodAmbiguities.title: Sleeve from CB: end point not stated
methodAmbiguities.detail: Assumed to be the finished cuff edge (cuff rib included); a leather cuff protector edge or the cuff seam are alternatives.

methodAmbiguities.title: Chest: circumference inferred, method not stated
methodAmbiguities.detail: Circumference is inferred (XS 43" cannot be a flat half; the Semifinalist × Golden Bear chart reads "Chest Circumference (one inch below Armhole)"). Whether it is flat × 2 or a tape round the body, and whether snapped closed, is not stated.

methodAmbiguities.title: Chest: "1 inch below armhole" reference
methodAmbiguities.detail: Assumed vertical 1" below the armhole point at the side seam. Not stated whether measured on the side seam or on the sleeve seam junction.

methodAmbiguities.title: Across shoulder: straight vs contour
methodAmbiguities.detail: Not stated whether straight point-to-point or following the back's curve; not stated whether measured at the seam line or the seam edge.

methodAmbiguities.title: Across shoulder on raglan styles
methodAmbiguities.detail: The same Classic chart covers The Ralston (raglan sleeve), where a shoulder point/seam does not exist. The chart does not say how its shoulder is taken there.

methodAmbiguities.title: Spec vs measured garment, tolerances, version
methodAmbiguities.detail: No tolerances, no chart date/version, and no statement whether values are pattern specs or measured production garments.

methodAmbiguities.title: One chart for several constructions
methodAmbiguities.detail: Classic covers melton/leather (Albany), all-wool (Portola), all-leather (Weldon) and raglan (Ralston) with one table. Golden Bear notes "Quilt lining adds bulk to the inside of the jacket, including the sleeves."

conflicts.detail: The site describes the one fit as "Standard Baggy Fit — roomy and relaxed, with a dropped shoulder". Golden Bear Classic (the chosen base) is published as a set-in sleeve block (one chart also covers the raglan Ralston). A dropped shoulder changes B09, S01, armhole and sleeve cap — it cannot be read from the Golden Bear chart. Decide set-in vs dropped before the pattern maker starts.

The configurator offers leather or "Cotton Fabric" for body and sleeves. Golden Bear's reference is melton wool / leather with quilted lining. No reference covers a cotton-fabric body; drape, bulk and the effect on fit must be checked on a sample in each material.
The ten zones are positioned on the 3D reference model and are identical for all sizes. They are not physical dimensions and were not measured on a garment.

Golden Bear and the S.i. Graphics template are imperial; the configurator and production sheet are metric. This draft keeps inches as the source values and states cm as exact conversions. The factory's working unit is TBD.

conversionToFactoryCm: Inputs locked per size after physical approval: zone box W × H (cm), zone centre from the primary anchor (Y) and secondary anchor (X).
Customer data per element (already stored): artwork aspect a = width / height; inZone = { scale s ∈ [0.2, 1], x, y } (shares of the box, x → right and y → up, facing the zone).
Auto-fit size: if a ≥ W / H then w₀ = W, h₀ = W / a; else h₀ = H, w₀ = H × a.
Finished artwork size: w = w₀ × s, h = h₀ × s (cm).
Customer offset from zone centre: ΔX = x × W, ΔY = y × H (cm, facing the zone). The software already clamps x, y so the artwork stays inside the box.

Artwork centre on the garment: Y below anchor = zone Y − ΔY. Body zones: X from CF/CB = zone X ± ΔX (front: + toward wearer's left as faced; back: mirrored). Sleeve zones: ΔX runs around the sleeve from its outer centre line.
Rotation: not supported in fixed zones (always 0).

Versioning: orders store physicalSize and referencePosition computed from the 3D boxes; once physical zones are approved, each order should record which zone-spec version it was produced against, so old orders are never re-interpreted.
Open decision: zones are the same for every size today. Whether physical zone positions/boxes grade by size or stay fixed is a pattern-maker decision (no source documents graded placement).
